footer.tagline: Discover the origins of Russian words, instantly

hero.title: Trace any Russian word back to its roots
hero.subtitle: Type or paste a Russian word and see where it truly comes from: the language it descends from, its original root meaning, and the words it's related to today.

lookup.title: Type or paste a Russian word
lookup.subtitle: Enter one or more Russian words, separated by spaces or commas. Works with your keyboard or a pasted block of text.
lookup.pasteHint: Typing and pasting (Ctrl+V) are both supported, on desktop and mobile.

results.title: Word origin breakdown
results.subtitle: Each result traces the word through its historical language family, its earliest reconstructed root, and words it shares that root with.
results.emptyBody: Enter a Russian word above, or pick one of the examples, to see its etymology here.
results.notFoundBody: This demo covers a handful of words. Try one of the examples above, or visit the full platform for the complete dictionary.

features.title: Built for people who are curious about words
features.subtitle: Whether you are learning Russian or just fascinated by language history, every lookup gives you more than a dictionary definition.

items.title: Instant breakdown
items.description: Get the origin language, root meaning, and related words the moment you submit a word, no manual research required.

items.title: Proto-Slavic and beyond
items.description: Many results trace back past Old East Slavic into Proto-Slavic and Proto-Indo-European reconstructions.

items.title: Cognate words included
items.description: See modern Russian words that share the same root, so you can spot patterns across vocabulary you already know.

howItWorks.title: From keystroke to word history
howItWorks.subtitle: Three simple steps turn a single word into its full linguistic story.

steps.title: Type or paste
steps.description: Enter a Russian word using your keyboard, or paste a word straight from another document or site.

steps.title: We trace the root
steps.description: The word is matched against its historical form and traced back through its language family.

steps.title: Read the full story
steps.description: See the origin language, the earliest root meaning, and the related words it left behind in modern Russian.

contact.title: Способы связи
contact.subtitle: Have a question about a word, or feedback on a result? Reach out directly.
contact.linkHint: The complete search engine, with its full word dictionary, lives at the link below.

cta.title: Curious about another word?
cta.subtitle: Scroll back up and look up as many Russian words as you like. There is no limit on a single session.
